purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Rostov-on-Don has a city geoportal that labels a “Land plots” map and references Rosreestr cadastral resources. Anonymous map-page HTML is accessible, but it presents account login and CAPTCHA controls, and no public geometry/schema was found or queried. The municipal help page refers to legacy 2010–2016 Rosreestr services, so current parcel service availability is unresolved.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Municipal Architecture and Urban Planning Department geoportal help page identifies the “Land plots” map and references Rosreestr cadastral services/open-data resources. This help page is legacy-dated and does not establish current data currency.

Anonymous GET of the city geoportal map page returned HTTP 200. Public HTML shows the city geoportal, search controls and “Land plots” map, but also presents a login/password/CAPTCHA form; no credentials or search submitted. It does not publish a vector geometry schema in the visible HTML.
Rosreestr open-data URL is referenced by municipal help content; no current city-point response was verified.
